title: Normalized coherent shift sequence on internal Hom cohomology
statement: Let C,R satisfy [def-per-local-rhom-normalization-interface] and K be any derived object. The uniquely normalized target shift of internal derived Hom induces a coherent shift sequence S on T0, with comparisons tau_n from S_n to Tn and tau_0=S.isoZero. Every Tn is additive and T0 is homological.
